rows.comparison_as_reported: carriers of the IFNγrs2069705C allele vs wild-type genotype (TT)
rows.note: Table 3 does not name the model for this row. The text describes the result as 'patients carrying the ... IFNγrs2069705C alleles', so the model is read as dominant (C carriers). Adjusted for age, sex, country, allo-HSCT and prophylaxis status. No genotype counts are reported.

rows.verbatim_source: IFNγrs2069705 per-allele OR, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.49 to 0.97; Ptrend = 0.032 (log-additive model of inheritance).
rows.note: The effect allele is taken as C, the protective allele named in the text. The p-value is Ptrend.

rows.comparison_as_reported: subjects harboring the IFNγrs2069705C allele vs wild-type
rows.note: The model is read as dominant (C carriers) from the text. Table 3 does not label it. No genotype counts are reported.

rows.comparison_as_reported: C allele carriers vs wild-type (dominant model, PDOM)
rows.note: The text gives PDOM = 0.0011 for IFNγrs2069705 in allo-HSCT patients, which supports a dominant model. Adjusted for age, sex, country, severe neutropenia and prophylaxis. Donor genotypes only, for IA occurring after transplant.

rows.verbatim_source: IFNγrs2069705 per-allele OR, 0.50; 95% CI, 0.26 to 0.95; Ptrend = 0.027 (log-additive model of inheritance).

rows.comparison_as_reported: C allele carriers vs wild-type (as in allo-HSCT comparison)
rows.verbatim_source: for IFNγrs2069705, OR of 0.24 [95% CI of 0.10 to 0.59] versus OR of 0.86 [95% CI of 0.52 to 1.45]
rows.note: Reported in the text only. No p-value, no stated model and no stated adjustment. The model is assumed to match the allo-HSCT comparison.

rows.verbatim_source: a relatively rare IFNγTC haplotype whose effect likely was due to the IFNγrs2069705 SNP (OR of 0.34 and 95% CI of 0.13 to 0.88; see Table S1
rows.note: The haplotype composition is presumably rs2069705 and rs1861494, but the allele order is not stated in the main text. Supplementary Table S1 was not available. The subgroup is assumed to be the overall cohort.

paper_note: Lupiañez 2016 (Infect Immun) reports adjusted logistic regression ORs only, with no genotype counts; rs2069705 C allele protective in phase 1, overall, and allo-HSCT (donor) analyses; the model for the main estimates is not labelled in the tables and is inferred as dominant from the text.
